page.layout: One printed page with one column of running text, no marginal notes. Running head at the top centre. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: dum ex undecimo primæ philo-sophiæ libro intelligere licet. Eorum denique quæ sunt, quædam nec actu neque[?] ipsa, nec ratione ulla à materia, concretioneque naturæ seiuncta separataque contemplamur: quo genere prima universi corpora consistunt, quæ quatuor elementa dicuntur, & a-lia omnia, quæ ex his constant, & concrescunt, quorum meditatio cognitioque physica philosophia & secunda ab Aristotele nominatur, libro divinæ philosophiæ quarto: quo in loco tot esse philosophiæ genera quot sunt rerum essentiæ perspicuè exprimit. Philosophi enim est substantiarum principia & causas meditari ac co-gnoscere, quemadmodum ibidē Aristoteles nos docet: quandoquidem proprie nullius accidetis

page.notes: Printed running head "DIVISIO" in spaced capitals; no page number printed. "réque" in the scan is read as "neque" with [?]. Printed "u-niversi" is hyphenated across the line as "v-niuersi"; read with u/v corrected. Catchword "scien-" is the first part of a word continuing on the next page. Slight blur in "concretioneque" and "universi" at the line ends, read with reasonable confidence.
